grants.title: Arrangementsutvikling innen idrett
grants.amount_note: You requested 80000 NOK, which is within the maximum of 350000 NOK.
grants.why_qualifies: The grant funds regional sports events run by volunteer clubs. Your two-day mountain running event for youth and adults is a regional event over several days that combines broad participation with volunteer involvement.
attachments: The grant page lists no required attachments. Check the application form on regionalforvaltning.no.
steps: Check that your club is registered in Frivillighetsregisteret.
Open regionalforvaltning.no, where all applications for this grant must be submitted.
Describe your event, including the number of participants, volunteers and any cooperation with other clubs.
Enter the requested amount of 80000 NOK and submit the application form.
Confirm the deadline on the grant page before applying.

grants.title: Tilskudd til friluftslivsaktivitet
grants.amount_note: The grant page gives no maximum amount. Ask the grant provider whether 80000 NOK is acceptable.
grants.why_qualifies: The grant supports organised outdoor activities that increase participation in friluftsliv. Your mountain running event for youth and adults is an organised outdoor activity, and your club is a volunteer membership organisation.
attachments: The grant page lists no required attachments. Check the application form on the Miljødirektoratet portal.
steps: Open the application portal of Miljødirektoratet from the grant page.
Fill in the electronic application form for your running event.
Send only one application, even if you plan several activities.
Enter the requested amount of 80000 NOK and submit the form.
Confirm the deadline on the grant page before applying.
